{{Infobox auto}}

'''Grilled melon''' is the simple preparation of the [[Melon|melon slice]]. It heals {{Value|Grilled Melon|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Fire Resistance}} for {{Value|Grilled Melon|duration|effect=Fire Resistance}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/grilled_melon.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A melon slice cooks into grilled melon in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in {{Value|Grilled Melon|cook_time}}. Picking up a melon slice unlocks the oven recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating grilled melon takes {{Value|Grilled Melon|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Grilled Melon|heals}} and gives Fire Resistance for {{Value|Grilled Melon|duration|effect=Fire Resistance|format=clock}}.

== Advancements ==
* ''Powerful Flavors'': cook an intrinsic ingredient. Obtaining any of the 11 simple preparations of the ordinary intrinsic ingredients completes it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/cook_food.json}}</ref>
